title: Keep the Wormhole ship-pointer browser checks deterministic
acceptance: The full-motion ship waits at the bottom with no pointer in the page.
The same browser test follows all four cardinal pointer bearings without changed tolerances.
The dead-zone check measures its held angle after the prior turn settles, without weakening its drift assertion.
A remembered hover reproducer fails before pointer setup and passes after it.
Required release checks pass without changing production pointer behavior.

evidence.note: Initial idle angle failed twice at 2.390 rather than -1.571.

Controlled remembered-pointer hover reproduced the exact failure, then passed three runs without retries after parking outside the page. Clean motion suite: 25 passed without retries. Required release checks: hygiene, audit (no high/critical), compatibility, diagram, fast unit tests (1851 passed, 2 skipped), build, first load (61.2 KB brotli of 64 KB), and browser gate (50 passed, 3 existing skips).

activity.summary: Claimed isolated test-only repair via Slack MFM; integration owner confirmed no competing edits.

summary: Control the idle test input before navigation; keep the production scene and all ship-angle assertions intact.
